notablePrerequisites: You have a way to create a token copy of Giant-Sized Flying Ant.
description:
Create a token copy of Giant-Sized Flying Ant.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a token copy of the Giant-Sized Flying Ant copy.
When the Giant-Sized Flying Ant token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Ghired.
Repeat from step 2.
